name: prompt-1061
image_purpose: convex-mirror distortion, urban street, and winter styling reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic nighttime street selfie reflected in a large convex road-safety mirror.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dark hair, soft friendly expression, white generic rabbit-ear headband, brown-and-white striped scarf, black winter coat, and a simple gold-toned clover-style bracelet with no brand identity.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject holds a smartphone near the convex mirror, with the reflection showing a wide-angle distorted intersection, cars, pedestrians, buildings, streetlights, wet pavement, and readable but generic street signage without personal data.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm streetlamp glow mixed with cool night blue, neon reflections on the mirror, realistic glass texture, cozy nighttime city mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 3:4, wide-angle convex distortion, realistic skin and jewelry texture, natural reflections, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman wearing a white generic rabbit-ear headband, brown-and-white striped scarf, and black winter coat takes a selfie in a large convex traffic mirror at a nighttime street intersection. Show realistic fisheye reflection of cars, pedestrians, buildings, streetlights, wet pavement, warm lamps, cool blue night tones, and soft neon reflections. Use generic jewelry with no brand mark or personal text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, distorted face, deformed hands, extra limbs, unreadable private data, branded jewelry logo, watermark, signature, cartoon, 3D render, horror, public figure likeness.
